text:
liz (eng-sre): heads up — next Thu 06:00-08:00 UTC we're running a graceful-degradation routing rehearsal + model-fallback simulation. Purpose: validate the new 'graceful-deg' routing policy and automated model-variant fallback to quantized_64 for latency/cost checks. expect small p95 blips, but no customer-visible errors planned. link to runbook: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/graceful-deg-rehearsal
sam (oncall): tagged the oncall rotation. i'll be primary for the window. what's the rollback trigger?
liz (eng-sre): rollbacks if: sustained p95 > 2x baseline for 10m OR error-rate > 0.5% for 5m after traffic shift. we'll also monitor correctness via smoke prompts set in the runbook.
maya (platform): will the rehearsal hit hosted and dedicated? curious about dedicated pools with pinned models.
liz (eng-sre): good Q — policy will run in hosted only for this sim. dedicated customers will be excluded (no config changes). dedicated plan for next month if this passes.
ryan (sre-lead): list of quick checks during the window: 
- validate KV cache warmup after fallback
- confirm batching behavior unchanged
- trace through routing logs for per-route decisions
- sanity-check cost per-token delta
ops-bot: maintenance scheduled: Thu 2026-03-26 06:00-08:00 UTC. Reminder 24h before and 1h before.
sam (oncall): can we get the exact traffic shift plan? how much % and ramp steps?
liz (eng-sre): ramp plan: 0 -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. each step 5-10m steady state. abort if rollback triggers hit.
maya (platform): adding the log filter we'll use for routing decisions: code:

FILTER: routing_policy=graceful-deg AND route in (chat,generate) AND model_variant!=primary

use this to grep request.log and trace export.
ryan (sre-lead): put this on the dashboard: p50/p95, error-rate, smoke-fail-count, model_variant_distribution. set alert to page at error-rate > 0.5%.
sam (oncall): noted. i'll mute noisy alerts except paging thresholds.
liz (eng-sre): quick runbook excerpt for execs — copyable: 
- purpose: validate graceful fallback path and quantify latency/cost impact
- scope: hosted API only
- expected impact: transient p95 increase up to ~200ms for affected routes, no error increase expected
- rollback: manual rollback to prev routing policy via infra-console OR automatic rollback on triggers above

Command we'll use for the traffic shift (example):
```
# shift 5% traffic to graceful-deg for route=chat
curl -X POST https://infra-api/routing/shifts \
  -d '{"policy":"graceful-deg","route":"chat","percent":5}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN"
```

maya (platform): i pushed a short smoke set to the monitoring job, 50 prompts across top intents. will report mismatch counts in the channel.
ryan (sre-lead): contingency: if correctness regressions > 1% or user-impact reports start, we rollback and open a P1 for investigation.
sam (oncall): do we need a comms note to #customers?
liz (eng-sre): not for this run — low blast radius. we'll include a short note in the weekly infra digest.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled for Thu 03:00 UTC (3h before).
maya (platform): after the run, i recommend a quick calibration: compare cost delta & latency per-token and update Optimize recommendations if quantized variant is viable.
ryan (sre-lead): thanks all. please ack here if you're on the bridge during the window.
sam (oncall): ack — i'll be on bridge.
liz (eng-sre): ack — i'll lead and own rollback. will post bridge link 30m before. :thumbsup:
